title: The non-Fano assignment costs at least 32 against a baseline of 30
body:
## Summary
- The displayed six readers cost at least `(8-1) + 4·(6-1) + (6-1) = 32`, above the five-target baselines 30 and 31.
- With `k` J axes, the one-role floor is `B0+6` and the two-role floor is `B0+k`, where `B0 = 30-3k`. Neither is a saving.
- Partial receipt only. No new kappa, and no coefficient sweep.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/nonfano-invoice-floor/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/nonfano-invoice-floor/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/nonfano-invoice-floor`
